lines.text: July the fifth, twenty seventeen. Bangkok. Just before dawn, a car rolls straight into the gate of a big white villa.

Upstairs, a twenty five year old Canadian is still awake at his laptop. He runs Alpha Bay, the biggest drug market on the dark web. More than a billion dollars has passed through it, and almost nobody knows his name.
He hears the crash, and he does exactly what the police were hoping for. He walks outside to look, and he leaves the laptop open.
He was not the first dark web boss to get caught. He would not be the last. So why does every single one of them end up in handcuffs?
For this one, the answer was hiding in a welcome email.
